text: i started going to church half a year ago, in boston. it was sporadic. i started off with the online sermons. my eyes were usually still swollen. i would test out a few, before i settled on going to one in person. there were a lot of old people. i'd hop around. it took at least a month before i dared to try one communion. the wine soured my tongue; i didn't think it would be real wine. i never went to the same church more than three times. when i came to san francisco, less than 12 hours after i landed in this city, i went to this one church. the very rev. malcolm young, he spoke about 1984 and brave new world. earlier this year i had just re-read brave new world again. passive control, he spoke about, and how ai is exactly that. i thought it funny, so on the nose, that of course the sermons in san francisco are about ai, and i'd come here for that, in the search for shoveling out west. i haven't gone to another church since. the very rev. young is leaving, i learned since that first sermon, and finally he really is leaving. today it was someone else, and they spoke about worshipping god from a place of abundance and not fear. i felt some fear about young being gone.

these days it's what i thought moving to sf would feel like. not bad but pretty empty. most times of the day i try to escape. always, since i was a kid. nowadays the vices are pretty pathetic, like going to the bathroom to bum a few reels. i don't feel much besides emptiness, mostly because i need sleep. i miss feeling euphoria in my chest. i don't get it much, but occassionally with music. what i really miss is feeling that about people. but i wonder if it's only really possible when i haven't got much to escape to otherwise, but for now i think ive got plenty. my head hurts. i miss you. good night

the back of my jaw bones up top - i hate it. it’s so constricting. today i haven’t felt as much to write about. i miss sk in the office. i feel weirdly detached from my past life and everyone in it, and i don’t know if this is a good or bad thing. pt said sf felt like a fever dream to him, which made more sense since he was leaving it any way, so it was never going to be a permanent thing, but i guess for me it’s a bit harder to tell. moving to my new apartment this week. was just there, spent an hour rearranging furniture and rearranging it back. sm had it all in an alright spot i guess and there really isn’t all that much you can do with a standard square studio. so it goes. the coffee table he sold me is quite nice though. i’ll need a pothos plant for it, it feels so nice. these days work bleeds everywhere but i don’t mind, when its not stress and it’s just work it’s quite fun. work feels like creating, and i like my coworkers, and all in all it’s nice, though sometimes i am scared i am losing touch of the real and true.

it hasn’t stopped raining. this morning the carways out front of gateway were flooded; i had sudden flashbacks to houston. met up with ak today. he seems a little lost - or rather rebirthing? i feel as though he made brash decisions rather than calculated ones though maybe it was the same for me, and many in sf. i don’t know. i think he’ll pass this period. i’ve felt more and more unmoored this days. maybe it was me who really made the brash decision. this evening our pod covered the Humanist AI talk, with mustafa and sarah and aaron. it came with this pristine papery stately coffee table book in which yuval and ken liu both wrote pieces. it was quite fascinating; my notes are hand taken elsewhere, though in short there were a lot of thoughts on society and AI, and mostly society. i felt that it was becoming a political debate and very soon, but thinking back only now do i start to see that even though politics is not everything everything is in politics. and here’s one more to hit the 12 though im not sure i counted all that correctly

i hate him. there’s not many people i hate and he’s one of them. i hope he rots in hell. i hate when karma isn’t real, or at least immediate. it’s kind of funny because he’s just my coworker and nothing is all that important but he’s also evil. well okay he mostly just doesn’t have a sense of integrity. i hate that i am at all associated to him on anything, and i hope he rots in hell. today it didn’t rain much which was nice. im in my new apartment right now so i could sleep wait on the laundry. will go back home in a bit now. i dont know how i feel lately, i think its the loneliness getting to me, living on my own. i need mooring.

today the riemann hypothesis was proved. overall the day was a bit... the word isn't stress inducing. fear inducing. i hold so many fears sometimes. i need to ask for remote work or time off. the day wasn't bad though. i had extremely overpriced yogurt, but my favorite part was getting closer to kl at the series d party. recently ive been laughing too much, i always have that uncontrolled off kilter laugh where my mouth is too open. the night ended up being pretty full with people and so i liked it. ks and ks from gdpval. gd and tt from hls. jf. and of course my fellow women in stem. there hasn't been much want lately, but i do want companionship. and just as it is in the name, i don't want much work or turmoil or fear, but pure and plain. it's hard to come by in fast batches, and it's not often it will stay in its initial stages, if ever. i had maybe three drinks tonight. im a little fuzzy now for sleep. kl asked a lot about my thoughts on layoffs, and fm is quite brutal, i can iamgine him (or perhaps not) on the oldest large paroject in the ods. my eyes can't stay open. ill call it now. i think it's hit 20.

yesterday i woke up with my head tight. i remember last night i wanted to write things, the lines had materialized while i brushed my teeth, then i forgot. lw/wzy might be autistic. he told me i love you last night. i’ve never felt so disconnected. not sure what’s wrong with me. it happened kind of suddenly when he asked if he could kiss me but im not all that surprised. he reminds me of my mom. there was a noon conversation with ac that stuck out, my conversations with him always stick out. he walked me down his list of series d party observations, and showed his old roommates cat videos, then abruptly walked away. AS has been on my mind lately. lw even suggested bar maritime yesterday, and i thought about how much AS would enjoy it. sometimes i think im a bit too pick me, like with women i get too comfortable, and with men i never feel comfortable. my voice goes high. maybe i am also just pick me. sometimes thats how it goes. im so excited to see cz/zxy today, i haven’t seen her in so long. i wish i could hang with AS again

i remembered what i wanted to write. it was that ez made me realize that actions and intent don't always correlate all that much, and now i never feel as much anymore, after that, but not in a bad way. i'd been so impressed then, that he would send playlists and read my books and write me essays and fly hours in and make cringe little philosophical instagram posts. now no one does that for me but when they do do something i know it often doesn't mean much anyway. the thing is you actually can tell. like with ez he actually wasn't all that hard to read, really, most of the time. he'd read or write, but then sometimes he'd talk, and you could tell, you usually always can tell. same with AS, you can easily tell. same with me, to lw. he kept trying to hold my hand when we were walking in chinatown, and i didn't know what to do, but i didn't especially want to be holding his hand. i went to church this morning and because he was there i invited him, but i didn't especially like that he was there at church. church is best done alone, and worst done with someone who i don't understand and doesn't understand me. this afternoon i finally saw cz/zxy again, i missed her a lot, and i also think she really has this solidly grasped, errantly lassez-faire attitude on life, and it's the kind that's quite mature, and that i haven't quite been able to access in sincerity, as much as i try to fake it. strong opinions, loosely held - not that, but it's the same aesthetic applied, in attitudes toward work. the opposite of tryhard, i guess. it's in the attitude, the personal beliefs though. i really did miss her, she's so fun and warm, though as always i always think she and these types have got a read on me that i don't quite get.
